# AOS-S Provider

This provider configures switches running HPE/Aruba AOS-S.  It has
been explicitly tested on switches in the 2350 family, but likely
works on others as well.

The provider logs into the switch using SSH and invokes config mode,
so the user you configure will need to be privileged.  Rather than
passing provider config in-line, you may also use `AOSS_HOST`,
`AOSS_USERNAME`, and `AOSS_PASSWORD` which will be picked up from the
environment.


## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "aoss" {
  host     = var.switch_host
  username = var.switch_user
  password = var.switch_pass
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `host` (String) The hostname or IP address of the switch to configure.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) The password used to authenticate to the switch.
- `username` (String) The username used to authenticate to the switch.
